options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

Definitions are copied from the v1 Metabase cards (exported 08-10-2026). Windows are relative to now. Because there is no backfill, the 30 to 90 day measures are not meaningful until about 90 days after go-live. As in v1, 'reactivated' needs no earlier session, so until the database holds 60 days of history every controller counts as reactivated.

panels.title: Active controllers
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 165. Distinct controllers with a session that started in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
-- Card 1: Active Controllers
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as count
FROM controller_summaries
WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

panels.title: Lapsed 30 days
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 166. Last session 30 to 60 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as count
FROM (
    SELECT cid
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
    HAVING MAX(session_start_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
       AND MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
) sub

panels.title: Lapsed 60 days
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 168. Last session 60 to 90 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as count
FROM (
    SELECT cid
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
    HAVING MAX(session_start_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
       AND MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days'
) sub

panels.title: Lapsed 90+ days
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 169. Last session more than 90 days ago.

targets.rawSql:
-- Card 4: Lost Controllers
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as count
FROM (
    SELECT cid
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
    HAVING MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
) sub

panels.title: Reactivated in the last 30 days after 60+ days lapsed
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 171. A session in the last 30 days and none 30 to 90 days ago. As in v1 this does not require an earlier session, so a brand-new controller counts.

targets.rawSql:
-- Reactivated: Active now after 60+ day gap
WITH controller_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        -- Active in last 30 days
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_last_30d,
        -- Sessions 30-90 days ago (the gap period)
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' 
                          AND session_start_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_30_90d_ago
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
FROM controller_activity
WHERE sessions_last_30d >= 1          -- Currently active
  AND sessions_30_90d_ago = 0  -- Was NOT active 30-90 days ago (60+ day gap)

panels.title: Controller retention rate
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 163. Active (30 days, sessions over 60 minutes) divided by active plus lapsed (a session 30 to 90 days ago and none in the last 30 days).

targets.rawSql:
-- Active vs Lapsed Ratio for Gauge Chart
-- Returns single percentage value (0-100) for gauge visualization
WITH active_controllers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as count
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      AND session_duration_minutes > 60
),
lapsed_controllers AS (
    -- Controllers last seen 30-90 days ago
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cs1.cid) as count
    FROM controller_summaries cs1
    WHERE cs1.session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND cs1.session_start_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM controller_summaries cs2
          WHERE cs2.cid = cs1.cid
            AND cs2.session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      )
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(ac.count * 100.0 / NULLIF(ac.count + lc.count, 0), 1) as percentage
FROM active_controllers ac
CROSS JOIN lapsed_controllers lc

panels.title: Activity levels of controllers
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 164. Current stage: Active Regular (4+ sessions in 30 days), Active Casual (1 to 3), Lapsing (last session 30 to 60 days ago), At Risk (60 to 90), Lost (90+).

targets.rawSql:
-- Controller Stage Distribution (Current State)
WITH controller_current_stage AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        CASE
            -- Active Regular: 4+ sessions in last 30 days
            WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') >= 4 
            THEN 'Active Regular'
            
            -- Active Casual: 1-3 sessions in last 30 days
            WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') BETWEEN 1 AND 3 
            THEN 'Active Casual'
            
            -- Lapsing: Last session 30-60 days ago
            WHEN MAX(session_start_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' 
             AND MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' 
            THEN 'Lapsing'
            
            -- At Risk: Last session 60-90 days ago
            WHEN MAX(session_start_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' 
             AND MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' 
            THEN 'At Risk'
            
            -- Lost: Last session 90+ days ago
            WHEN MAX(session_start_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' 
            THEN 'Lost'
            
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END as stage
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
)
SELECT 
    stage,
    COUNT(*) as controller_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) as percentage
FROM controller_current_stage
WHERE stage != 'Unknown'
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY 
    CASE stage
        WHEN 'Active Regular' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Active Casual' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Lapsing' THEN 3
        WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Lost' THEN 5
    END

panels.title: S1 new controller retention by cohort
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 173. Controllers first seen in the last 12 months whose first session was S1 (rating 2), by first-session month: share with a session 25 to 35, 55 to 65 and 85 to 95 days later. v1 drew a line chart; this is a table of the same figures.

targets.rawSql:
-- S1 Cohort Retention (v1 card 173)
WITH cohort_definition AS (
    SELECT
        cid,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(session_start_time)) as cohort_month,
        MIN(session_start_time) as first_session
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
    HAVING MIN(session_start_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months'
),
s1_cohorts AS (
    SELECT cd.*
    FROM cohort_definition cd
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM controller_summaries cs
        WHERE cs.cid = cd.cid
          AND cs.session_start_time = cd.first_session
          AND cs.rating = 2
    )
),
cohort_retention AS (
    SELECT
        cd.cohort_month,
        cd.cid,
        cd.first_session,
        CASE WHEN cd.first_session <= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM controller_summaries cs
                WHERE cs.cid = cd.cid
                  AND cs.session_start_time >= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '25 days'
                  AND cs.session_start_time <= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '35 days'
            )
        ELSE NULL END as active_day_30,
        CASE WHEN cd.first_session <= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' THEN
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM controller_summaries cs
                WHERE cs.cid = cd.cid
                  AND cs.session_start_time >= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '55 days'
                  AND cs.session_start_time <= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '65 days'
            )
        ELSE NULL END as active_day_60,
        CASE WHEN cd.first_session <= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM controller_summaries cs
                WHERE cs.cid = cd.cid
                  AND cs.session_start_time >= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '85 days'
                  AND cs.session_start_time <= cd.first_session + INTERVAL '95 days'
            )
        ELSE NULL END as active_day_90
    FROM s1_cohorts cd
),
cohort_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN active_day_30 = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
              NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN active_day_30 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1) as retention_rate_30,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN active_day_60 = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
              NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN active_day_60 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1) as retention_rate_60,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN active_day_90 = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 /
              NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN active_day_90 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 1) as retention_rate_90
    FROM cohort_retention
    GROUP BY cohort_month
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(cohort_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort, cohort_size,
       retention_rate_30 AS "Day 30 (%)", retention_rate_60 AS "Day 60 (%)", retention_rate_90 AS "Day 90 (%)"
FROM cohort_stats
ORDER BY cohort

panels.title: Who might need help reactivating?
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 177. Reactivated controllers (see the reactivated count) whose sessions in the last 30 days were all under 18 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH controller_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        MAX(name) as name,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN rating = 2 THEN 'S1'
            WHEN rating = 3 THEN 'S2'
            WHEN rating = 4 THEN 'S3'
            WHEN rating = 5 THEN 'C1'
            WHEN rating = 7 THEN 'C3'
            WHEN rating >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
        END) as rank_group,
        MIN(session_start_time) as first_session,
        MAX(session_start_time) as last_session,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_last_30d,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' 
                          AND session_duration_minutes < 18) as short_sessions_last_30d,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' 
                          AND session_start_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_30_90d_ago,
        SUM(session_duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as total_minutes_since_return,
        MAX(session_duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as longest_session_minutes
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
)
SELECT 
    cid,
    name,
    rank_group,
    first_session::date as first_session,
    last_session::date as last_session,
    sessions_last_30d as recent_sessions,
    ROUND(total_minutes_since_return / 60.0, 1) as hours_last_30d,
    longest_session_minutes
FROM controller_activity
WHERE sessions_last_30d >= 1          -- Currently active
  AND sessions_30_90d_ago = 0         -- Was NOT active 30-90 days ago (60+ day gap)
  AND sessions_last_30d = short_sessions_last_30d  -- ALL sessions are < 18 minutes
ORDER BY last_session DESC
) q LIMIT 500

panels.title: Who reactivated after being away for more than 60 days?
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 172. The controllers behind the reactivated count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
-- List of Reactivated Controllers (EXACT SAME LOGIC as count query)
WITH controller_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        MAX(name) as name,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN rating = 2 THEN 'S1'
            WHEN rating = 3 THEN 'S2'
            WHEN rating = 4 THEN 'S3'
            WHEN rating = 5 THEN 'C1'
            WHEN rating = 7 THEN 'C3'
            WHEN rating >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
        END) as rank_group,
        MIN(session_start_time) as first_session,
        MAX(session_start_time) as last_session,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_last_30d,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' 
                          AND session_start_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as sessions_30_90d_ago,
        SUM(session_duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as total_minutes_since_return
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
)
SELECT 
    cid,
    name,
    rank_group,
    first_session::date as first_session,
    last_session::date as last_session,
    sessions_last_30d as recent_sessions,
    ROUND(total_minutes_since_return / 60.0, 1) as hours_last_30d
FROM controller_activity
WHERE sessions_last_30d >= 1          -- Currently active
  AND sessions_30_90d_ago = 0         -- Was NOT active 30-90 days ago (60+ day gap)
ORDER BY last_session DESC
) q LIMIT 500

panels.title: Lapsing controllers (30+ days inactive)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 167. Controllers with no session for 30 or more days, most lapsed first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
-- Most Lapsed Controllers (30+ days inactive, sorted by days lapsed)
WITH controller_last_session AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        MAX(name) as name,
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 2 THEN 'S1'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 3 THEN 'S2'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 4 THEN 'S3'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 5 THEN 'C1'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 7 THEN 'C3'
            WHEN MAX(rating) >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
        END AS rank_group,
        MAX(session_start_time) as last_session,
        MIN(session_start_time) as first_session,
        COUNT(*) as total_sessions,
        SUM(session_duration_minutes) as total_minutes
    FROM controller_summaries
    GROUP BY cid
)
SELECT 
    cid,
    name,
    rank_group,
    last_session::date as last_active,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - last_session)::INTEGER as days_since_last_session,
    first_session::date as first_ever_session,
    total_sessions,
    ROUND(total_minutes / 60.0, 1) as total_hours_ever,
    -- Lapse category
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - last_session) >= 90 THEN 'Lost (90+ days)'
        WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - last_session) >= 60 THEN 'At Risk (60-89 days)'
        WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - last_session) >= 30 THEN 'Lapsing (30-59 days)'
        ELSE 'Recent (0-29 days)'
    END as lapse_category
FROM controller_last_session
WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - last_session) >= 30  -- 30+ days inactive
ORDER BY days_since_last_session DESC  -- Most lapsed first
) q LIMIT 500

panels.title: Controller engagement index (last 90 days)
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 174. Sessions and average session length per controller over 90 days, with quadrant and lapse risk. v1 drew a scatter plot; this is a table of the same figures.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
-- Engagement Matrix: Frequency vs Duration (FIXED - No Duplicates)
WITH controller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cid,
        MAX(name) as name,  -- Use MAX to avoid grouping issues
        CASE 
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 2 THEN 'S1'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 3 THEN 'S2'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 4 THEN 'S3'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 5 THEN 'C1'
            WHEN MAX(rating) = 7 THEN 'C3'
            WHEN MAX(rating) >= 8 THEN 'I1+'
        END AS rank_group,
        COUNT(*) AS session_frequency,  -- X-axis
        ROUND(AVG(session_duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_session_duration_hours,  -- Y-axis
        ROUND(SUM(session_duration_minutes) / 60.0, 1) AS total_hours  -- Bubble size
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE session_start_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY cid  -- ONLY group by cid to avoid duplicates
)
SELECT 
    cid,
    name,
    rank_group,
    session_frequency,
    avg_session_duration_hours,
    total_hours,
    CASE 
        WHEN session_frequency >= 12 AND avg_session_duration_hours >= 1.5 THEN 'Super Engaged'
        WHEN session_frequency < 12 AND avg_session_duration_hours >= 1.5 THEN 'Casual but Committed'
        WHEN session_frequency >= 12 AND avg_session_duration_hours < 1.5 THEN 'Frequent but Brief'
        ELSE 'At Risk'
    END AS engagement_quadrant,
    CASE 
        WHEN session_frequency < 4 AND avg_session_duration_hours < 1.5 THEN 'High Risk'
        WHEN session_frequency < 10 AND avg_session_duration_hours < 1.5 THEN 'Medium Risk'
        ELSE 'Low Risk'
    END AS risk_of_lapsing,
    -- Numeric field for coloring
    CASE 
        WHEN session_frequency >= 12 AND avg_session_duration_hours >= 1.5 THEN 4  -- Super Engaged = Green
        WHEN session_frequency < 12 AND avg_session_duration_hours >= 1.5 THEN 3  -- Casual = Light Green
        WHEN session_frequency >= 8 AND avg_session_duration_hours < 1.5 THEN 2  -- Frequent Brief = Yellow
        ELSE 1  -- At Risk = Red
    END AS color_value
FROM controller_metrics
ORDER BY total_hours DESC
) q LIMIT 500

panels.title: Controller activity trends
panels.description: v1 Metabase card 176. By month: controllers active, reactivations (active this month but not the month before; as in v1 this includes controllers seen for the first time) and lapsed (active last month, not this month). v1 drew a combo chart; here bars for the first two and a line for lapsed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH monthly_controllers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', session_start_time) as month,
        cid
    FROM controller_summaries
    WHERE session_start_time IS NOT NULL
        AND cid IS NOT NULL
),
controller_history AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.month,
        mc.cid,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev.cid IS NULL THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END as is_reactivation
    FROM monthly_controllers mc
    LEFT JOIN monthly_controllers prev 
        ON mc.cid = prev.cid 
        AND prev.month = mc.month - INTERVAL '1 month'
),
lapsed_controllers AS (
    SELECT 
        prev.month + INTERVAL '1 month' as month,
        COUNT(*) as lapsed_count
    FROM monthly_controllers prev
    LEFT JOIN monthly_controllers curr 
        ON prev.cid = curr.cid 
        AND curr.month = prev.month + INTERVAL '1 month'
    WHERE curr.cid IS NULL
    GROUP BY prev.month + INTERVAL '1 month'
)
SELECT 
    ch.month,
    SUM(ch.is_reactivation) as reactivations,
    COUNT(*) as total_active_controllers,
    COALESCE(MAX(lc.lapsed_count), 0) as lapsed
FROM controller_history ch
LEFT JOIN lapsed_controllers lc ON ch.month = lc.month
GROUP BY ch.month
ORDER BY ch.month
